name: MegaRobotics M100W
summary: The wheel-legged version of the MegaRobotics M100: 79 kg, 50 kg continuous payload, 200 mm wheels on the feet and IP67, built by an OEM partner. Meant for long patrol routes, substation inspection and material transport on large sites outside Ex zones.

germany.statusNote: Sold by MegaRobotics (MegaForce GmbH, Kaarst) as its own brand, built by an OEM manufacturing partner; "Sourcing on request", "Inquiry only", price on request. The page says CE conformity is in preparation.

sellers.note: "Contact for pricing"; own brand for the DACH region: "MegaRobotics supplies, integrates and services the M100W in the DACH region, built by an OEM manufacturing partner." CE conformity is in preparation.
